public_rules.fact: Wait for the first five-minute candle at the New York open.
Close above EMA12 implies long; below implies short.
No fixed profit target; trailing stop; hold until unspecified exit rules trigger.
Instrument NAS100; M5; adjustable preset risk 1% per trade.
Never simultaneous long and short. Overnight positions 45%; weekend positions 12%.
Four steps are waiting for New York, direction, wide stop, letting the move run. Step details explicitly require subscription.

public_evidence.counterexample: Two implementations with identical public entry and no fixed target but different wide-stop distances and trailing rules can produce different trades; public sources cannot distinguish them. The local mandatory same-day exit additionally conflicts with reported original overnight holdings.
